PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Hold the Crouch key to crouch, release it to stand up. Hybrid and vanilla toggle modes in the settings.
PluginData.Description:
Crouch while the Crouch key is held, stand up when it is released. A quick tap toggles instead (Hybrid mode, the default).
Usage: - Hold Crouch (C by default) to crouch, release it to stand up - Uses the game's Crouch binding, keyboard or controller - Pressing Crouch while crouched still stands you up - No headroom, falling or jetpack on when you release: you stand up as soon as you can
Settings (Settings button in the Pulsar plugin list, also in game): - Crouch mode: Hybrid (default), Hold or Toggle (vanilla) - Hybrid: a tap under 0.25 s toggles, a longer press works like Hold - Applies immediately, saved in Storage/PolarsHoldCrouch.cfg
No effect in cockpits, seats, on ladders, in spectator, in menus or while chat is open.
Client-side only, no server install. No Harmony patches. Tested in single player and on a dedicated server.
Known issues: none reported.
Bugs and suggestions: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsHoldCrouch/issues
